_note: SYNTHETIC TEST STORE, made up by us: Store Lab's AudioDealz page (storelab/audiodealz/), not a real shop. Recorded on 27 Oct 2026 with the real agents (STORELAB_DEMO=on, orchestrator on), not the scripted demo, to show the red verdict.

final_card.title: Don't buy here
final_card.subtitle: Risky store · 3 tricks · real total $191, not $149

reasons.text: No address or company record found for this store
Product photos are copied from another store
70% of reviews were posted in a single week
Fake 40% off: it was $149 for 81 of 90 days
$37 in fees appear at checkout step 4
$255 minus a $26 card offer, free shipping
Skipped Store B (refurbished), Store D (unsafe store) and Store E (couldn't check)

findings.summary: Pressure message: "Only 2 left in stock - order soon.". Stock claims can't be verified from the page.

Product photos are copied from another store.
70% of reviews were posted in a single week.
Only 5 days to return items.
$37.01 in fees appear only at checkout step 4 (service $22.00 + processing $15.01). Real total: $191.00.
